motion-spec.text:
Full spec in repo: design/MOTION_SPEC.md. Part 1/2 (curves, model, fades-only, geometry, expand, collapse) — see "motion-spec-2" for prev/next, delete, peek hover, autosave, empty-note error, reduced motion, implementation notes.

MOTION SPEC · ENLARGED SIDEBAR VIEW (v2 — shared-element morphs)
Source: LottieFiles motion-design skill. Personality: Corporate / "Enterprise SaaS" (director/context-adaptation.md: 200–400ms, low intensity). All values at 1x; the prototype has a "slow (4x)" tweak.

CURVES (reference/timing-easing-tables.md, directional rules)
· std = cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), MD3 Standard. "On-screen" rule: every element that exists in BOTH views starts and ends on screen, so every morph uses std.
· acc = cubic-bezier(.3,0,1,1), MD3 Accelerate. Exits and fade-outs.
· No bounce and no overshoot anywhere (Corporate: 0–3%).

MODEL: SHARED ELEMENTS vs FADES
Elements that exist in both views never fade. They travel from their old rect to their new one:
1. the sidebar background (panel)
2. the clicked note's thumbnail
3. the thumbnails of its list neighbours (the previous and next notes)
4. the logo and wordmark, which ride the panel's left edge
Everything that exists in only one view fades in place. No slide, no scale.

FADES ONLY (never move)
· list view only: theme and close buttons, the "add note / export / import" row, "this page (n)", every other list item (thumbnail and text), and the list note text of the three shared notes
· enlarged view only: rail buttons (x, ↑, ↓), "feedback #n" and "n / total", the note editor (textarea and bar), delete, the "saved" hint, the empty-note error
· both: the number badge on a thumbnail (fades out as it settles into the main slot or either peek — NEVER visible at rest on main or peeks), and the 2-line caption under a peek

GEOMETRY (1440 viewport; panel = 75% = 1080)
· list slot: 267×100, radius 10
· main slot: 720×380, radius 10, screenshot inset 28
· peek slots: 540×285 (75% of main, exactly), right edge flush with the right edge of the x/↑/↓ rail. The prev peek sits above the title and is cut off by the panel's top edge. The next peek sits below the editor and is cut off by the bottom edge. No number badge on peeks (or on the main slot) — see FADES ONLY.
· hard clip only: the panel has overflow:hidden. No gradients, masks, blur or backdrop-filter anywhere.

EXPAND (click a list note)   total ≈ 500ms
· t0: capture the list rects of the note and of its prev/next (after scroll; include the dock-magnified transform if hovered). Hide the real list thumbnails (visibility:hidden) and put the floating clones exactly on top.
· 0–450ms, std: the panel grows leftward, width 300 → 1080 (duration table: page transition 400–600 = Corporate "slow" 450; distance scaling: full screen = 1.8x of 250).
· 0–450ms, std, same curve: the clicked thumbnail morphs from its list slot into the main slot. Prev and next morph from their list slots into the peek slots. Same curve and duration as the panel, so the cards never outrun the panel edge. The panel's left edge is always left of the cards.
· 0–200ms, std: the scrim fades in (multi-element: Modal with Content, backdrop first)
· 0–150ms, acc: the list-only elements fade out (entrance-exit: Dissolve Exit, no scale)
· 150ms+: the peek captions fade in over 250ms
· 200 / 250 / 300ms: the title, editor and rail fade in over 200ms, std (multi-element: List Items, Corporate 200ms with 50ms stagger in reading order; total stagger 100ms)
· edge case: if a neighbour's list slot is scrolled out of view, it does not morph. It fades into its peek slot (200ms, std, 150ms delay).
· at the end: focus moves to x

COLLAPSE (x, esc or a scrim click) = the exact reverse, about 75% of the duration (entrance-exit: exits are 65–75% of the entrance)
· 0: scroll the list (still hidden) so the current note is centred. Recompute its list rect and its neighbours' list rects.
· 0–120ms, acc: the title, editor, rail and peek captions fade out
· 0–340ms, std: the panel contracts rightward 1080 → 300, while the main card shrinks back into its list slot and the peeks shrink into theirs (same curve, same duration)
· 150–300ms: the scrim fades out, acc
· 150–350ms: the list-only elements fade back in, std (100–150ms overlap: entrance-exit continuity)
· at the end: swap the clones for the real list thumbnails. They are pixel-identical, so there is no visible change. Focus goes to the list item.

motion-spec-2.text:
Full spec in repo: design/MOTION_SPEC.md. Part 2/2 (prev/next, delete, peek hover, autosave, empty-note error, reduced motion, implementation notes) — see "motion-spec" for curves, model, fades-only, geometry, expand, collapse.

PREV / NEXT (↑/↓, rail buttons, or click a peek): a carousel of morphs, 400ms, std
· next: the next peek grows into main. Main shrinks into the prev peek slot. Old prev peek fades out in place (150ms acc). The note after next fades into the vacated next-peek slot (200ms std, 200ms delay). "prev" is the mirror.
· title/editor content crossfades (not morphs): out 120ms acc, swap, in 180ms std. Rail and panel stay still.
· 400ms = "shared element morph" in multi-element: Page Transition. Block input until it settles.

DELETE
· 0–180ms acc: main card shrinks to scale(.95) and fades out (Collapse Exit). Title/editor fade out same window.
· at 180ms note is removed. If notes remain: index snaps to min(old, len-1) — normally "next" becomes main; if the LAST note was deleted, the prev peek morphs into main instead (mirrors "prev") and the note before it fades into the vacated prev-peek slot. Same 400ms std carousel as NEXT; title/editor crossfade back in (180ms std). Total ≈580ms, input blocked to 600ms.
· if that was the ONLY note left: skip the carousel — run COLLAPSE directly back to the list's empty state. Delete is exempt from the empty-note nav lock below.

PEEK HOVER (open view, pointer only)
· hovered peek moves by transform ONLY: prev (top) peek translateY(+7px) down; next (bottom) peek translateY(−7px) up. Nothing else changes.
· enter 90ms, leave 180ms, both std — tighter than the general hover band (single-property transform).
· keyboard focus shows the normal ring but does NOT trigger the lift. Reduced motion: no lift ever, ring only.

AUTOSAVE ("✓ saved" hint)
· typing updates the draft immediately; only the hint is debounced. 700ms after the last keystroke: hint (check icon + "saved", aria-live polite) fades in 150ms std, holds 1400ms, fades out 300ms acc (opacity-only, no scale/bounce).
· blur / navigation / collapse force an immediate save (skip the debounce) before their own transition starts, so the hint is never clipped mid-fade.
· failure: same slot shows "couldn't save note. try again." (danger, 150ms std fade-in), stays until the next save succeeds.

EMPTY-NOTE ERROR (blocked navigation — "a note can never be empty")
Inline Validation recipe (state-feedback.md), scaled to Corporate/low-intensity and non-spatial (no slide):
· textarea border → danger, 150ms std, colour only.
· error text ("a note can't be empty. add some text to continue.") fades in 200ms std, in place, in the saved-hint's slot.
· optional: ONE tiny shake on the first blocked attempt only — ±4px, 2 cycles, ease-in-out, 200ms total (toned-down Error Shake: normally ±10–15px/300–400ms). Never under reduced motion; never repeats while already showing.
· clears on first non-whitespace keystroke: border 150ms std, error text fades out 120ms acc.

REDUCED MOTION: no spatial motion, crossfades only, ~halved durations. Expand ~184ms, collapse ~200ms, prev/next & delete's carousel → fade-out(75ms acc)-snap-fade-in ~220ms. Peek lift and dock magnification (src/dockMotion.ts) fully off. Autosave hint / empty-note error unaffected (opacity/colour-only) except the shake, always suppressed.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES (condensed — full detail in design/MOTION_SPEC.md §13)
· FLIP with real DOM in the closed shadow root: measure source rects once at t0 (never in rAF); destinations are pure math (slot()); key clones by note id, identity never swaps mid-flight.
· screenshot: counter-scale the inner image (tween its own w/h/radius) rather than scaling the whole card — list (2.67:1) vs peek (1.89:1) aspects differ; interpolate border-radius as its own px value, not via transform scale.
· panel: width 300→1080 (simplest, matches resize code) vs clip-path/translateX (compositor-only, needs pointer-events care) — ship width first.
· prefer Web Animations API over CSS transitions for morphs (currentTime/finished/reverse enable retargeting); CSS transitions are fine for plain fades.
· interruptibility: don't just drop a second ↓/delete under a busy flag — retarget the live animation (preferred) or queue one pending step; entering add mode cancels the enlarged view instantly, no half-collapse frame.
· teardown: one cancel() per gesture clears every timer/rAF/Animation and removes clone DOM/restores visibility, called before each new gesture and on unmount/navigation.
· capture: hide the ENTIRE shadow root before any screenshot via hideOverlayUI()/showOverlayUI() (src/addMode.ts) — enlarged view and add mode are mutually exclusive so one flag suffices.
